$comment: Apify actors GoVIRAL may run, and the topic sets it runs them on. The Free plan's $5 monthly platform credit is the budget guard: when it is spent the actors stop, so overspend is impossible and no cash is at risk. Upgrading the plan needs a new owner approval — Starter is $29/mo and does not fit the $30 all-in cap.

actors.freeLimit: $5 Apify platform credit per month, shared account-wide
actors.termsNote: Logged-out public data only. Meta v. Bright Data (N.D. Cal. 2024) held that Meta's terms do not bar scraping public data without an account; this actor takes no login and no cookie, so the owner's own accounts are never involved.

$recipeComment: The weekly scout, priced against the $5 credit with margin. maxResults is a hard cap, not a target — the guard drops steps in reverse order when the month is running hot, so the last step listed is the first to go. Weekly is about $1.03 and a month about $4.60.
$accountComment: Public accounts whose posts step 4 watches for deltas. Owner-editable. Empty is a legitimate state — step 4 simply does not run, and the week's scout is smaller rather than failed.
